description: Bicycle Permanent Station Counts is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. This dataset comprises cyclist counts collected at the City of Winnipeg’s permanent count stations. Each station utilizes an inductive loop sensor, which detects metal from bicycle wheels (rims) as they pass over the sensor and disturb the electromagnetic field. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Transportation Planning & Traffic Management. Its tags are counts, bicycles, active transportation, inductive loops, cycling. The table has 9 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
